features.name: Tell me on mobile
features.description: The alt Q keyboard shortcut support for Tell me has been added to mobile devices, allowing users to search for pages and reports. Can be enabled via feature management and works on phones and tablets in landscape and portrait modes.
caveats: Must be enabled in feature management

features.name: Search for data on mobile
features.description: Users can now search for data from the Tell me search experience on mobile devices. The feature uses the same scoping as desktop and administrators can configure which tables are accessible.
caveats: Must be enabled in feature management
Permissions are honored same as desktop

features.name: Worksheet pages on mobile phones
features.description: Support for worksheet pages is coming to mobile phones in version 23.1. Previously these showed an error on phones. The new implementation will work like document pages with header, footer, and line-by-line editing.
features.status_evidence_quote: coming in version 23.1 so not right now in October but a little bit later in November time frame

features.name: Native barcode scanning via camera
features.description: Native barcode scanning capability on mobile devices using the device camera. Supports 1D and 2D barcode formats including QR codes. Uses machine learning for barcode detection. Can be enabled via AL language with extended data type property.
caveats: Requires AL extended data type annotation

features.name: Barcode scanning via dedicated devices
features.description: Integration with dedicated barcode scanning hardware devices for Business Central. Third integration option for barcode scanning capabilities.
caveats: Only supported in mobile app version 4.0 or later
Only supported in Business Central release wave 2

features.name: Barcode scanning button in UI
features.description: New button in the UI that invokes camera scanning capability. When tapped, the camera opens for barcode scanning and the scanned data is sent to AL for processing.
caveats: Requires annotating field with barcode extended data type

features.name: AL barcode scanning API
features.description: New AL extensibility allowing developers to integrate barcode scanning capabilities via AL language. Can be used with fields, actions, buttons, links, or automated logic.
caveats: Scanned data must be processed by AL logic

features.name: Item references with barcode type
features.description: New reference type called barcode for item references allowing identification of item variants. Can specify validity dates for reference numbers and print barcode labels.

features.name: GTIN barcode label printing
features.description: Ability to print barcode labels for Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) assigned to items. Supports multiple barcode formats including 1D and QR code formats.

features.name: Item bin content inquiry with barcode scanning
features.description: New action in warehouse worker role center allowing scanning of barcodes to get item bin content details. Can scan GTIN or reference numbers to retrieve item location and quantity information.

features.name: Barcode scanning in sales orders
features.description: Support for scanning barcodes to select items in sales order lines. Users can scan item reference numbers instead of selecting from dropdown.

features.name: Scan multiple item tracking action
features.description: An action in item tracking lines that enables continuous scanning of serial numbers for multiple packs without manual intervention between scans.

features.name: Camera barcode scanning provider
features.description: An AL-based barcode scanning provider that uses device camera to scan barcodes, with support for success and failure triggers for post-processing.

features.name: Barcode scanner provider API
features.description: AL API for developers to register barcode scanner providers and listen for incoming barcode data with uniform naming conventions across camera and dedicated scanner implementations.
caveats: Multiple providers can register but only topmost page receives data

features.name: Barcode received trigger
features.description: An AL trigger that fires when barcode data is received from either camera scanning or dedicated scanner devices for further processing.
